We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_5_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule. We have the mapped_rxn and template_id from that input: mapped_rxn: 'O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O>>O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O' Wait that seems same on both sides? Might be placeholder. But we have template_id 12345. We need to apply that template to the molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = given SMILES, template_id = "12345".
